limits: Methods: the rules export records no HTTP method selection, and Cloudflare's documented default charges GET only, so whether POST requests to these paths are charged is unverified.
Origins: paying clears the gateway only; whether each origin then serves a paid caller without its own credential has not been verified.
Eligibility: Cloudflare's Monetization Gateway requires buyers and sellers to be based in the United States.
Revenue: this catalog records prices, not settlements; it says nothing about whether any payment has settled.
